scenes.narration: Break a curve into five intervals. Interior endpoints meet in opposing pairs and cancel out, leaving only the outer boundary endpoints.

visual.heading: Fundamental Theorem in 1D
visual.caption: Every interior point is added once and subtracted once.

scenes.narration: Tile a surface with tiny spin loops. Shared interior walls carry opposite flows that cancel completely, leaving only the outer perimeter loop.

visual.heading: Green's & Stokes' Curl
visual.caption: Internal circulation cancels along every shared edge.

scenes.narration: Measure outward flux from each square tile. Flow leaving one cell enters its neighbor and cancels, leaving only flux across the outer rim.

visual.heading: 2D Divergence
visual.caption: What leaves one interior tile immediately enters the next.

scenes.narration: Stack unit cubes in space. Opposing fluxes on shared inner faces cancel out, leaving only outward flux through the outer shell.

visual.heading: 3D Divergence Theorem
visual.caption: Isometric volume cells cancel on shared interior faces.
